Not relocated: the ordered-avx512 crate's m3pmem.c postimage d912c43c3d47 (adds dot_avx512_ordered; AVX-512F/BW) and its SelfTest postimage f2c2188dc578; the q8/q8red crate chains (preimage a8e5aaecf12b/4484c734c134 predates develop's #14554/#14573 corrections: SUPERSEDED by the live owner); the pmem-inference-jmod-20261030 accelerator family (CpuAffinity, NativeBindings, NumaExecutor, PmemRegion, GgufInspector, PmemProbe, its m3pmem.c and SelfTest: NUMA scheduling and thread affinity need the family's JNI library and a multi-node host).

# Package decision: both donor packages (com.synexia.m3.accelerator.pmem, com.m3.accelerator.pmem) map to the NON-EXPORTED package jdk.internal.m3.optane of module org.m3jdk.optane (JDK naming standard: internal packages jdk.internal.m3.<area>, the area being the module's; module-info.java unchanged, exports jdk.m3.optane only), as recipe/pmem-gram-index-20261106 did for the campaign package. The accelerator is a candidate ("Candidate for a future jdk.m3.accelerator.pmem product JMOD", donor Javadoc), not a public API.

# Owner decision: m3/optane already owns a persistent-memory region family (M3PmemSdk/M3PmemRegion/M3PmemMapping/M3PmemTransfer/M3PmemSearch over m3pmemsdk.c, FILE/POSIX/PMDK backends, read-write, fail-closed). M3PmemAccelerator maps a read-only tensor file (mmap PROT_READ), reports FS-DAX through statx(STATX_ATTR_DAX), pins the calling thread to a NUMA node's cpulist and runs a bounded signed-Q8 x FP32 matrix-vector kernel in strict column order: same shape (a mapped region), other contract (tensor kernel, DAX classification, thread pin, read-only) = NEC, both kept; nothing of the SDK is edited. The JNI library is separate (m3pmemaccel, new CMake target: MERGE row), so the SDK library's export set is unchanged.

# Row kinds: FILE donor path (repository root) -> target path (module root m3/optane). PACKAGE donor package -> target package. TYPE donor type -> target type. JNI donor JNI symbol prefix -> target prefix (every line, C and Java). TEXT literal text -> replacement (every line). DROP_METHOD <DonorType>.<method> -> reason (the whole declaration removed before the other rules). MERGE: an existing module file edited for the leaf (apply.py, EDITS.tsv). SKIP: donor files this leaf does not relocate -> reason.
